items.structure: Lobes of Right Lung (superior, middle, inferior)
items.section: Lower Respiratory Tract Components > Lungs, Tracheobronchial Tree, and Surrounding Respiratory Structures
items.note: Lungs absent; lobes could be approximated from right segmental bronchial trees (bodyparts)
items.custom_note: Lungs are absent in both donors. Built from the thoracic cavity of BodyParts3D: inside the ribs, intercostals, sternum and vertebrae, above the diaphragm, lateral to the heart/pericardium, great vessels, trachea and oesophagus; apex domed over the first rib. Voxels are assigned to the lobe whose segmental bronchial trees are nearest, so each lobe envelops its own segmental bronchi. Lungs are drawn in quiet-expiration size (they stop short of the costodiaphragmatic recess).
